children: Eureka Acquisition entered into an unsecured, no-interest convertible promissory note to fund a one-month SPAC deadline extension. Marine Thinking deposited $8,253.03 into the trust account on September 3, 2026, and received the note dated October 7, 2026. The note is payable upon the earlier of Eureka’s business combination or the company’s expiry and may convert into private units at $10.00 per unit. The extension moves the deadline to October 3, 2026 while preserving deal optionality with Marine Thinking.
